capabilities: embed interactive real-world and image maps in notes via code blocks
create draggable markers and circle overlays linked to notes, websites, or commands
generate markers from note frontmatter, folders, tags, or links using Dataview
load GeoJSON and GPX files onto maps
measure distances, switch tile layers, and invert map colors for dark mode
extras: The README states the plugin is in maintenance mode: PRs and bugs are reviewed but feature requests will not be worked. It warns that bugs may delete data and recommends automated backups; marker data associated with removed map blocks is deleted after 7 days. Marker CSV export is described as still under development.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display interactive maps or geographic data inside notes.

relations.evidence: If the Initiative Tracker plugin is installed, a battlemap can be opened from the Initiative Tracker view.
Adds interactable mapping functionality to Obsidian.md, using Leaflet.js

summary: Interactive map embeds for notes using Leaflet.js code blocks, supporting real-world and image maps with markers, overlays, GeoJSON and GPX.
